page: Microsoft Azure EC32ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on AMD EPYC 9V74 processors. The instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with multithreading enabled on the x86_64 architecture. It includes 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. Dedicated hardware caches supply 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache per core cluster, with instruction set support for AVX-512, VNNI, and cryptographic accelerators like VAES and SHA-NI.

Storage consists of a 1288 GB local SSD array alongside support for Azure Premium Storage disks. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs. Benchmark results display strong single-thread execution, placing in the top quartile for stress-ng single-core tests and Geekbench single-core performance at 1955.0 points. Multi-threaded metrics fall in the middle tier, marked by a Geekbench multi-core score of 15752.0 and PassMark CPU score of 45527.55. PassMark encryption operations scored 35708.91, reflecting hardware cryptographic capabilities.

Operational benchmarks show mid-range data throughput, generating 40.45 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks and standard throughput on PassMark database evaluation. The high memory capacity and integrated local NVMe-equivalent SSD deliver effective resource density for memory-bound tasks without requiring high-tier compute configurations.

This hardware profile is targeted at memory-intensive workloads that require substantial working sets and low-latency local scratch space. Fitting applications include relational and in-memory databases, Redis caches, large-scale ETL pipelines, and enterprise enterprise analytics platforms.
description: Microsoft Azure EC32ads_v6 is a memory-optimized cloud server powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. The configuration delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores, 256.0 GB of memory, and 1288 GB of local SSD storage, while omitting discrete GPU accelerators. Architected with an 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio, the system features hardware instruction support for AVX-512 and advanced cryptography. Synthetic benchmarks show top-quartile single-core metrics across Geekbench and stress-ng tests, alongside mid-range multi-core performance and strong cryptographic execution. Memory and database metrics place within the middle quartile, demonstrated by Redis SET performance reaching 40.45 million operations per second. The balance of high memory density, solid single-thread performance, and fast local SSD storage positions the EC32ads_v6 for in-memory databases, distributed caching, enterprise transactional engines, and data processing workloads.
